name: Block Domain
author: Paul Schoenmakers
description: Block or unblock a sender's domain in Stalwart's server-wide blocked-domains list, directly from the message list or the Spam folder.

stalwartUrl.label: Stalwart URL
stalwartUrl.description: The address of the Stalwart server. The plugin calls its JMAP endpoint at <this address>/jmap/.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.description: A least-privilege API key that may query and change blocked-domains lookup entries and run ReloadLookupStores.

en.settings.blockTarget.label: When the sender is on a subdomain
en.settings.blockTarget.description: Choose whether to ask each time, block only the exact sender domain, or block its registrable base domain and all of its subdomains.
en.target.base: Block the base domain and all subdomains
